id: # SkipClicks: one-click survey. A new option only: vanilla's Perform a survey stays.

# SkipClicks: salvage and cargo pods. Each rule steps in only where vanilla's rule would have run (SKC_Skip check asks the game which rule wins without SkipClicks); another mod's rule there runs untouched.

conditions:
!HostileFleetNearbyAndAware
SKC_Skip check none SalvageCheckHostile sal_noHostileNearby score:100000

$option == salSalvage
SKC_Skip check none DialogOptionSelected option:salSalvage sal_optionCheckAccidents score:100000
SKC_Skip check skc_skipFindContinue SalvageSpecialFinished sal_specialFinished score:100000
SKC_Skip check skc_skipDefendersContinue BeatDefendersContinue sal_continuePostDefenders sal_continuePostDefendersDerelict score:100000

$customType == cargo_pods
!$locked
SKC_Skip check skc_skipPodsExamine OpenInteractionDialog pods_start score:100000
